description: Implementation of the SetMute class which manages muting functionality for a media pipeline within the Rialto server project. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute method that sets the mute state using a GstWrapper.

classes.name: SetMute
classes.description: A class responsible for setting the mute state of a media stream within the Rialto server's generic tasks namespace.

methods.name: SetMute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetMute object with context, GstWrapper, and mute state.

methods.name: ~SetMute
methods.description: Destructor for the SetMute class, logs when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the mute setting operation by calling gstStreamVolumeSetMute on the GstWrapper.
